description:
Responsible for driving hotel sales, revenue growth, distribution channel development, and social media-driven customer acquisition. The role focuses on maximizing occupancy, room rates, RevPAR, and overall business revenue through effective sales strategies, pricing, OTA management, and digital marketing initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
A. Sales & Revenue Management
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and occupancy targets across hotels.
Manage OTA platforms, direct sales channels, corporate accounts, group bookings, and business partnerships.
Develop pricing strategies, promotional packages, and distribution plans to optimize revenue.
Monitor sales performance, booking trends, ADR, and RevPAR.
B. Social Media & Customer Acquisition
Manage social media channels, including TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Douyin, WeChat Channels, and Xiaohongshu.
Coordinate with the influencer marketing team on KOL campaigns, hotel reviews, and promotional activities.
Convert social media inquiries and potential customer leads into actual bookings through effective coordination with sales and customer service teams.
Track content performance, booking conversion, and customer acquisition costs.
C. Reporting & Team Coordination
Prepare regular sales and revenue performance reports and propose improvement plans.
Coordinate with hotel operations, front desk, finance, and marketing teams to ensure effective execution of sales activities.
Support new hotel launches, including pricing, OTA setup, and initial sales strategies.
requirements_text:
Requirements
Minimum 5 years of experience in hotel sales, OTA operations, or revenue management.
Experience in hotel chains, multi-property operations, boutique hotels, or serviced apartments is preferred.
Proven ability to develop corporate accounts, sales channels, and business partnerships.
Hands-on experience in social media operations, content planning, and digital customer acquisition.
Strong analytical, commercial, communication, and coordination skills.
Ability to translate marketing activities into measurable bookings and revenue.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Business Performance: Sales target achievement, occupancy rate, ADR, RevPAR, and profitability.
Channel Efficiency: OTA and direct booking revenue, conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, and repeat bookings.
Management & Execution: Revenue forecast accuracy, reporting quality, and execution of key business initiatives.
Kiến thức ngành
Nhà hàng / Khách sạn
Kỹ năng cần có
Analytical Skills, commercial skills, Sales & Revenue Management, OTA operations, Social media operations
Kỹ năng nên có
Boutique Hotels, Serviced Apartments, Hotel chains, Multi-property operations
